proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Rana lasʌn “garlic” (f_7e5jy4uvuuixk). Family evidence: CDIAL 10990 laśuna gives lasun/lasaṇ garlic in its first branch and rasuna in its second. The simple l-initial forms fit the first branch; larasun has extra rhotic morphology needing review. Reviewed comparison: Rana lasun “garlic” (f_uuo7s273nj5vw). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Kathoriya mute “urine” (f_dqc2gfnagz5tm). Family evidence: CDIAL 10234 mūtra explicitly gives Kalasha mūtra, Bshk. mūλ and Western Pahari mūc. The survey lateral/sibilant outcomes fit the tr-cluster urine family; retroflex muṭ and ordinary mute preserve the same noun, with phonetic details left open. Reviewed comparison: Buksa mut “urine” (f_fgdpypslzzy6u). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
